chapters.name: Discover
chapters.title: Start from the data you already have.
chapters.description: Browse every connected warehouse and file, then drag a table onto the canvas.

chapters.name: Build
chapters.title: Build on a canvas, in plain SQL.
chapters.description: Add steps visually. Table names in your SQL become the dependencies.

chapters.name: Intellisense
chapters.title: Complete columns, not guesses.
chapters.description: Column-level completions with types that flow from upstream assets.

chapters.name: Type check
chapters.title: Catch mistakes as you type.
chapters.description: The whole pipeline is type-checked before anything runs.

chapters.name: Jinja
chapters.title: Template with Jinja.
chapters.description: Variables complete and render inline, and the rendered SQL is checked too.

chapters.name: Run
chapters.title: Run it, see the results.
chapters.description: Every asset reports fresh data, row counts and output types.

chapters.name: Staleness
chapters.title: Only rebuild what changed.
chapters.description: Edits mark downstream assets stale. Build stale skips everything still fresh.

chapters.name: Deploy
chapters.title: Review it, then ship it.
chapters.description: Deploy a pinned snapshot to a protected production environment.

chapters.name: Schedule
chapters.title: Schedule it and move on.
chapters.description: Runs every morning in prod from the deployed version, and catches up after downtime.
